title: libexpat through 2.10.0 Isolated High Surrogate via UTF-16 Conversion
description: CVE-2026-134703 is a vulnerability in libexpat versions 3.0 and 4.0 involving isolated high surrogate characters during UTF-16 conversion. The issue relates to improper handling of Unicode surrogate pairs, categorized under CWE-176 (Improper Handling of Unicode Encoding). No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. No patch or remediation details are available from the vendor or source data.
